name: West Dunbartonshire
title: West Dunbartonshire —
tagline: Dumbarton Rock, Clydebank's shipyards and the bonnie banks of Loch Lomond.
summary: West Dunbartonshire has Dumbarton Rock, a volcanic plug that was capital of the ancient kingdom of Strathclyde, and Clydebank, where great liners such as the Queen Mary were built.
Loch Lomond lies at its northern edge, and the Clyde here has a long maritime story.
